    // that is too deep, at the mapped type, whichever node first requests it.

        N extends 5 ? 4 : N extends 4 ? 3 : N extends 3 ? 2 :

        N extends 1 ? 0 : 0;
    type Recur<N extends number, S> =
        N extends 0 ? S : Recur<Dec<N>, [S]>;
